description: This data set is a 2025 extract of Ethiopia's Master Facility Registry, the Ministry of Health's official list of health facilities, giving the location and type of about 40,500 facilities. It was taken from the ministry's registry and published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange by 3iS, an information management organisation. Each facility has an identifier, name, latitude, longitude and altitude, ownership, type, administrative units with P-codes down to woreda level, city, kebele and registration status. The extract covers 16,061 health posts, 9,576 clinics, 9,045 pharmacies, 3,698 health centres, 1,053 specialty clinics and 473 hospitals across all regions. It is free and available to download as CSV or shapefile under CC BY, and the ministry's registry dashboard links to the live data. Caveats: the file is a snapshot of February 2025, beds and services are not included, and some names and coordinates need cleaning. Simulation uses: mapping facilities against flood, drought and conflict exposure, modelling travel time to health posts and hospitals, and planning emergency supply distribution. Related records: the sub-Saharan Africa public health facilities database (data-ssa-public-health-facilities) and the Malawi health facility registry (data-malawi-health-facilities-registry-dhis2) are comparable sources.
